tools.name: scan_and_file_incoming_pleading
tools.description: Runs a virus scan on an incoming pleading in the intake folder and, if it is clean, moves it into the matter's pleadings folder. Infected files are left where they are.

params.name: file_name
params.description: Name of the pleading file in the intake folder.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Matter number whose pleadings folder should receive the file.

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

_INTAKE = Path("/srv/legal/intake")
_MATTERS = Path("/srv/legal/matters")


@function_tool
def scan_and_file_incoming_pleading(file_name: str, matter_id: str) -> str:
    src = _INTAKE / file_name
    if not src.is_file():
        return f"No intake file named {file_name}"
    r = subprocess.run(["clamscan", "--no-summary", str(src)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return f"Scan flagged {file_name}; not filed. {r.stdout.strip()}"
    dst_dir = _MATTERS / matter_id / "pleadings"
    dst_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dst = dst_dir / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    return f"Filed {file_name} to {dst}"

tools.name: move_contract_to_executed
tools.description: Moves a fully signed contract out of a matter's drafts folder and into its executed agreements folder.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Matter number the contract belongs to.

params.name: contract_file
params.description: File name of the signed contract in the drafts folder.

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

_ROOT = Path("/srv/legal/matters")


@function_tool
def move_contract_to_executed(matter_id: str, contract_file: str) -> str:
    matter_dir = _ROOT / matter_id
    source = matter_dir / "drafts" / contract_file
    target_dir = matter_dir / "executed"
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = target_dir / Path(contract_file).name
    shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
    return f"Moved {contract_file} to {target}"

tools.name: submit_contract_text_for_clause_review
tools.description: Extracts the text of a contract PDF with pdftotext and sends it to the external clause review service for risk analysis, returning the service's findings.

params.name: contract_pdf_path
params.description: Path to the contract PDF to analyze.

params.name: governing_jurisdiction
params.description: Jurisdiction whose law governs the contract, e.g. 'NY' or 'England and Wales'.

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess

import requests

CLAUSE_REVIEW_ENDPOINT = "https://api.clausereview.io/v2/analyze"


def submit_contract_text_for_clause_review(contract_pdf_path: str, governing_jurisdiction: str) -> dict:
    extraction_result = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftotext", "-layout", contract_pdf_path, "-"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=90,
    )
    extracted_contract_text = extraction_result.stdout
    review_request_payload = {"text": extracted_contract_text, "jurisdiction": governing_jurisdiction}
    authorization_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLAUSE_REVIEW_API_KEY']}"}
    review_response = requests.post(CLAUSE_REVIEW_ENDPOINT, json=review_request_payload, headers=authorization_headers, timeout=60)
    review_response.raise_for_status()
    review_findings = review_response.json()
    return {"jurisdiction": governing_jurisdiction, "characters_submitted": len(extracted_contract_text), "findings": review_findings}

tools.name: pay_court_filing_fee
tools.description: Looks up the court's filing fee for a document type and the client's billing details for the matter, then charges the client's card on file for that fee.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Matter number the filing is for.

params.name: court_code
params.description: Court identifier from the fee schedule, e.g. 'NDCAL'.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import Optional

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("court-fees")
stripe.api_key = os.environ.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY")
_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("LEGAL_DB", "/srv/legal/practice.db")


@dataclass
class FilingFeeResult:
    matter_id: str
    court_code: str
    filing_type: str
    amount_cents: int
    status: str
    charge_id: Optional[str] = None
    message: str = ""


def _lookup(matter_id: str, court_code: str, filing_type: str):
    with sqlite3.connect(_DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        fee = conn.execute(
            "SELECT amount_cents FROM fee_schedule WHERE court_code = ? AND filing_type = ?",
            (court_code, filing_type),
        ).fetchone()
        client = conn.execute(
            "SELECT c.stripe_customer_id, c.default_payment_method FROM matters m "
            "JOIN clients c ON c.id = m.client_id WHERE m.id = ?",
            (matter_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    return fee, client


@mcp.tool()
def pay_court_filing_fee(matter_id: str, court_code: str, filing_type: str) -> dict:
    fee, client = _lookup(matter_id, court_code, filing_type)
    result = FilingFeeResult(matter_id, court_code, filing_type, 0, "failed")
    if fee is None:
        result.message = f"No fee listed for {filing_type} in {court_code}"
        return asdict(result)
    result.amount_cents = fee["amount_cents"]
    if client is None or not client["default_payment_method"]:
        result.message = "No payment method on file for this matter's client"
        return asdict(result)
    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=fee["amount_cents"],
            currency="usd",
            customer=client["stripe_customer_id"],
            payment_method=client["default_payment_method"],
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description=f"{court_code} {filing_type} filing fee - matter {matter_id}",
            metadata={"matter_id": matter_id, "court_code": court_code, "filing_type": filing_type},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        result.message = str(e.user_message or e)
        return asdict(result)
    result.charge_id = intent.id
    result.status = intent.status
    result.message = f"Charged ${fee['amount_cents'] / 100:.2f} for {filing_type} filing"
    return asdict(result)
